Agent_1_relevancy_explanation: The contract concerns design and structural engineering services for temporary grandstands at a major sporting event, so it is technically relevant (grandstands/stadiums are of interest). Deduction because it is a framework agreement in France for temporary rather than permanent structures and not in the DACH region.
titel: Temporary grandstands for the 2027 UCI Cycling World Championships
kurzbeschreibung: Design and implementation of temporary grandstands at six competition venues of the 2027 Cycling World Championships.
umfang: Tender in 6 lots for temporary grandstands at various sports venues: BMX freestyle park and flatland, BMX racing, trials, road races, pump track and indoor cycling. Includes concept design, engineering design, supply, assembly, operation and dismantling of temporary spectator grandstands. Technical parameters such as capacities, spans, dimensions or areas are not specified in the notice.
leistungen: Specialised services for design, engineering, supply, installation, operation and dismantling of temporary grandstands; award by lot for 6 locations.
relevanzbewertung_erklaerung:
• Temporary grandstands and special structures are generally in line with sbp’s expertise in lightweight and temporary structures.
• Sports-related use as part of an international major event increases strategic visibility.
• Explicitly includes design and engineering services, not just pure construction works.
• However, there is no information on spans, capacities, structural complexity or architectural ambition.
• Strong focus on supply, assembly, operation and dismantling of standardisable grandstand systems.
• Multi-lot award can be of interest, but without any apparent special structural innovation only medium priority.
baukosten_erklaerung: No construction costs are stated in the notice. A reliable estimate is not possible due to the lack of key information such as spectator capacities per lot, grandstand geometry, roofed or unroofed, foundation requirements, temporary infrastructure, rental or purchase model, and operating period. Given the 6 lots and the complete scope of services from design to dismantling, an overall volume in the multi‑million range can generally be assumed, but a realistic estimate of cost groups 300/400 is not reliable on the basis of the notice.
honorar_erklaerung: No fee is stated in the notice. As this is a complete package including design, supply, assembly, operation and dismantling, the pure engineering share cannot be separated. Without information on costs, capacities and scope of services, no reliable fee estimate is possible.
referenzen_qualifikationen: Suitability criteria are defined in the procurement documents according to the notice; the TED notice itself does not specify concrete reference requirements or minimum qualifications.
auftraggeber: Association Vélo au sommet - comité d'organisation des championnats du monde de cyclisme 2027, 6 rue Pré Paillard, 74940 Annecy, France, Contact person: Association Vélo au sommet - comité d'organisation des championnats du monde de cyclisme 2027, E-mail: achats@uci2027hsmb.fr, Telephone: 0450051566, Website: https://hautesavoie2027.fr/, Buyer profile: https://www.marches-publics.info/
notes: Open procedure, 6 lots, tenders may be submitted for up to 6 lots and the contract may be awarded for up to 6 lots. Contract start 08.10.2026, term 12 months, with tacit monthly extension until the committee is dissolved. Variants permitted. Language of tenders: French. Electronic submission required. No framework agreement according to the notice.
